state.title: Probe simctl ui tap

part.text: I reached the search screen and entered `news`, but the simulator’s only available controls do not include any way to tap the “Open” button on the system confirmation dialog. I couldn’t complete the final switch to the `Feeds` tab because the modal blocked the app and no touch automation tool was available.
